# Exact owner plan

## Behavior owners

- `heichelos/post/logic/listeners/AutoScrollButton.js`: visible click must call immediate toggle.
- `heichelos/post/actions/autoScroll/AutoScrollController.js`: do not attach automatic interruption observer.
- `heichelos/post/actions/autoScroll/AutoScrollSession.js`: remove countdown/interruption startup responsibilities from ordinary session start.
- `heichelos/post/actions/autoScroll/AutoScrollWiring.js`: keep explicit pause API but stop wiring automatic gesture/interruption behavior into the session.
- `AutoScrollControlCopy.js`: collapse visible state language to Start/Stop.

## Reader UI owners

- `reader-settings.html`: primary Focus, text size, Auto Scroll, compact Appearance disclosure.
- `AutoScrollSemanticControls.js`: one speed control, no unit/preset/eye-line dashboard.
- `sidebarContent.js`: shorter labels and no explanatory prose in the visible grid.
- `panel-rows/menu-button.css`, `menu-copy.css`, `menu-tabs.css`: compact two-column mobile commands, no `!important`.

## Ikar owners

- `semantic/fallback.html`: Ikar bilingual/public title and concise library description; remove readiness chip language.
- `ikar-first.js`: do not rewrite title back to operational language; concise discovery heading.
- `premium/ikar-first-parts/part-03.css`, `part-04.css`, `part-05.css`, `part-06.css`: stronger hero/card hierarchy, remove numbered-dashboard visual and unnecessary status ornament.

## Verification

- Auto Scroll tests plus a new immediate-start/continuous contract test.
- `test:imported-style-ownership`, `test:css-quality`, `test:heichelos-quality`.
- Mobile browser measurements: one click moves immediately; movement continues through at least two intervals until Stop; Stop remains stable.
- Mobile screenshot/DOM checks for menu, Lens, and Ikar root.

## NEXT_ACTION

Rewrite owners completely, then run verification before deployment.
